sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Which of the following sets includes all the species that will change the orange colour of $\ce{K2Cr2O7}$ in acidic medium ?
stem.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस समुच्चय में वे सभी स्पीशीज़ हैं जो अम्लीय माध्यम में $\ce{K2Cr2O7}$ के नारंगी रंग को बदल देंगी ?

feynman.en: Orange dichromate turns green only when it is reduced to $\ce{Cr^3+}$, so every species in the set must be a reducing agent.
feynman.hi: नारंगी डाइक्रोमेट तभी हरा होता है जब वह $\ce{Cr^3+}$ में अपचयित हो, अतः समुच्चय की प्रत्येक स्पीशीज़ अपचायक होनी चाहिए।

steps.en: The other sets contain $\ce{Fe^3+}$, $\ce{Sn^4+}$ or $\ce{SO4^2-}$, which are already in their highest common oxidation states and cannot reduce dichromate.
steps.hi: अन्य समुच्चयों में $\ce{Fe^3+}$, $\ce{Sn^4+}$ या $\ce{SO4^2-}$ हैं, जो पहले से अपनी उच्चतम सामान्य ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था में हैं और डाइक्रोमेट को अपचयित नहीं कर सकते।
